purpose: Prospective paired representation transport study with every scientific degree of freedom fixed before P7.4B outcome materialization.

A1_fixed_deployment_reference.initial_identity_source: raw indices [800,1000) after frozen warm-up and before stage 1
A1_fixed_deployment_reference.RI_identity_source: exactly the last 200 raw observations of the current D_assess after the candidate receives the frozen adaptation procedure and before the selected RI identity is committed
A1_fixed_deployment_reference.scale_dynamics: store once at identity birth and hold fixed for the entire active identity tenure
A1_fixed_deployment_reference.RI_reset_rule: discard the old S_m and response history; construct the selected new identity's S_m by the identical deployment-reference rule before commitment

features.history_rule: same-identity causal response history including current stage; reset after identity change

feature_preprocessing.fit_statistic: per-feature arithmetic mean and population standard deviation with ddof=0
feature_preprocessing.zero_standard_deviation_rule: replace a zero fitted standard deviation by 1.0
feature_preprocessing.fold_rule: fit independently for A0 and A1 on rows from the current 18-center Fit training fold only, then transform that fold's held-out six Fit centers
feature_preprocessing.final_fit_rule: after OOF evaluation, fit each representation's scaler on all 24 RepresentationFit centers only, then freeze before opening RepresentationValidation

target_numerical_scaling.type: fixed unit conversion only; no fitted target scaler
target_numerical_scaling.training_rule: multiply the scientific target by its fixed representation multiplier before MSE optimization
target_numerical_scaling.prediction_rule: divide raw model output by the same fixed multiplier before every metric and before applying the theoretical zero boundary
target_numerical_scaling.implementation_inspection: compatible with the frozen full-batch Adam/MSE path; no numerical inconsistency found before outcomes
target_numerical_scaling.future_numerical_inconsistency_rule: STOP_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW; never select a multiplier from outcomes

estimator.loss: mean squared error in fixed numerically converted target units
estimator.paired_initialization_rule: A0 and A1 use the identical seed for the corresponding fold or final fit; initialization is restarted separately from that seed

fit_evaluation.strategy: four-fold Group CV by center on RepresentationFit
fit_evaluation.fit_metric_predictions: one out-of-fold prediction per Fit record from the model that did not train or scale on that record's center

reference_scale_audit.floor_activation_rate_denominator: all constructed identity scales in the corresponding pool
reference_scale_audit.floor_activation_rate_rule: STOP if activations / all constructed identity scales is strictly greater than 0.01 in either RepresentationFit or RepresentationValidation

RI_selection_optimism.status: known prospectively registered limitation; not future-service leakage
RI_selection_optimism.mechanism: the RI candidate is evaluated on D_assess and the selected identity's S_m is constructed from that same causal D_assess

metric_definitions.macro_center_Spearman: compute Spearman within each center over all included seeds, scenarios and stages, then take the arithmetic mean across all pool centers; undefined center values count as not positive and make the corresponding absolute proceed condition fail
metric_definitions.positive_Spearman_center_fraction: number of all pool centers with finite within-center Spearman strictly greater than zero divided by all 24 pool centers
metric_definitions.non_C3_macro_center_Spearman: same macro-center definition after excluding C3 records within every center; undefined center values count as not positive and make the condition fail
metric_definitions.admission_positive_class: R_B50/S_m<0 for A1 and R_B50<0 for A0; predictions use the corresponding scientific target units and the fixed zero boundary
metric_definitions.center_TPR: within-center fraction predicted negative among oracle-negative records; undefined if that center has none
metric_definitions.center_TNR: within-center fraction predicted nonnegative among oracle-nonnegative records; undefined if that center has none
metric_definitions.macro_TPR: arithmetic mean of finite center TPR values
metric_definitions.macro_TNR: arithmetic mean of finite center TNR values
metric_definitions.zero_boundary_balanced_admission_accurac: 0.5*(macro_TPR+macro_TNR); report numbers of centers defining each class; if either macro component is undefined, STOP

bootstrap.sampling_rule: sample 24 RepresentationValidation centers with replacement and retain every record for each sampled center; duplicated centers receive duplicated center weight
bootstrap.paired_rule: use the identical sampled center index vector for A0 and A1
bootstrap.interval: percentile interval at [0.025,0.975] using NumPy linear quantiles
bootstrap.undefined_replicate_rule: STOP if any required statistic is undefined or fewer than exactly 4000 paired replicates are available

prospective_validation_criteria.paired_validation_uncertainty: At least one of the two paired 95% bootstrap intervals has lower bound strictly greater than zero, and the other interval does not have upper bound strictly less than zero.

fit_to_validation_deterioration.rule: STOP if A1 deterioration is strictly greater than A0 deterioration on both macro-center Spearman and zero-boundary balanced admission accuracy

leave_one_validation_center_out.rule: For each of the 24 Validation centers, remove that center and re-evaluate every A1 absolute condition, both paired point estimates, and the paired bootstrap uncertainty rule with 4000 resamples and seed 2904 on the remaining 23 centers. STOP if any one-center removal makes any otherwise-held proceed condition fail.
leave_one_validation_center_out.interpretation: no single center may be necessary for all proceed conditions

execution_order_after_separate_authoriza: A: materialize paired RepresentationFit records only
B: fit A0 and A1 using the frozen folds, preprocessing, architecture, seeds, optimizer, loss, schedule, and terminal-epoch rule
C: freeze both fitted feature scalers, both estimators, representation formulas, code/config/input hashes, and Fit OOF results
D: only after both pipelines are frozen, open RepresentationValidation once
E: compute the predeclared metrics and stop rules without refit, threshold tuning, scale-statistic tuning, feature change, model selection, or outcome-dependent replacement
F: stop for human scientific review under every result

claim_boundary.PASS_may_support_only: The fixed deployment-reference representation improves prospective cross-center recoverability transport relative to the paired absolute representation under the evaluated synthetic protocol.
must_not_establish: P8 readiness without separate human review
